record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Show that Bartnik quasi-local mass is strictly positive for non-flat data, and show that Penrose quasi-local mass is nonnegative on reasonable data.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let (M, g, K) be an asymptotically flat initial data set for the Einstein equations consisting of a 3-manifold M with Riemannian metric g and symmetric (0,2)-tensor K representing the second fundamental form, satisfying the dominant energy condition. For a bounded domain Ω ⊂ M with smooth boundary Σ = ∂Ω, the Bartnik quasi-local mass m_B(Ω) is defined as

  m_B(Ω) = inf { m_ADM(M̃, g̃, K̃) },

where the infimum is taken over all admissible asymptotically flat extensions (M̃, g̃, K̃) of (Ω, g|_Ω, K|_Ω) that contain no horizons enclosing Ω and satisfy the dominant energy condition. Call the data on Ω "non-flat" if (Ω, g|_Ω, K|_Ω) is not locally isometric to a region in Minkowski initial data.

Similarly, for a closed spacelike 2-surface Σ bounding a region in a spacetime satisfying the dominant energy condition, let m_P(Σ) denote the Penrose quasi-local mass associated with Σ (defined via the area and properties of trapped/marginally trapped surfaces enclosed by Σ).

Prove the following two assertions:
(a) For every bounded domain Ω with non-flat initial data, m_B(Ω) > 0.
(b) For every closed 2-surface Σ arising as the boundary of a region in physically reasonable initial data (satisfying the dominant energy condition with no naked singularities enclosed), m_P(Σ) ≥ 0.
artifact.status_search_result: Partial results exist: Huisken–Ilmanen type results show that vanishing Bartnik mass forces local flatness in the time-symmetric (Riemannian) case, and the Riemannian Penrose inequality (Huisken–Ilmanen, Bray) gives nonnegativity in the time-symmetric setting. However, the full strict positivity of Bartnik mass for general non-flat (non time-symmetric) data and nonnegativity of the Penrose quasi-local mass on general reasonable spacetime data remain open in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Embeddings, Immersions and the Bartnik Quasi-Local Mass Conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of Bartnik mass conjectures including positivity/rigidity for non-flat data.
status_evidence.claim: The strict positivity/rigidity of Bartnik quasi-local mass is formulated as a conjecture, with partial results in the time-symmetric case.

status_evidence.title: The Bartnik mass (Living Reviews)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of properties and known results about Bartnik quasi-local mass.
status_evidence.claim: Survey indicates the positivity property is established in restricted settings, with the general case being a long-standing problem.

status_evidence.title: An overview of Bartnik's quasi-local mass
status_evidence.snippet: Overview paper from 2024 discussing the status of Bartnik mass conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Recent overviews continue to treat positivity/rigidity of Bartnik mass as an active research problem rather than fully settled.
